planned_title: Why Did a 90-Day Mars Rover Last 14 Years?
replaces_for_review: wed11_opening_testA_v02 (scheduled TtgHNLXfDSs). v01, v02, v03 and v04 not overwritten.
spoken: 14 years. on Mars. Dust should have choked its solar panels within months. Martian wind kept sweeping them clean. The team called them cleaning events. Each one gave the rover back its power, and it kept driving. Ninety days became years. Then in 2018, a storm wrapped the whole planet and the sky went dark.
